about_the_game:
ITRP _ Vacuum Bless is an exploration puzzle game about exploring a spaceship and solving puzzles in zero gravity.

Welcome to the space program!

In the frameworks of this program, you could’ve navigate through endless space, but instead, have to focus on the way to get out of the spaceship which got stuck in space.

Alone within million kilometers

You have to rely only on yourself. Study the ship's plan. Explore the available rooms. Find ways to get into new sections, expand the spaces. And don't forget to get special equipment, it will come in handy.

A ship full of riddles

Literally. Use your brain and the ability to fly to solve all the puzzles you encounter along the way. It's so good that there is zero gravity in space, the puzzles seem to have been made for it.

Please, remind me what mission was it…

Wait, why there are no two-factor security systems on this spaceship? No captain’s cabin? Who has placed so many mysteries here and why? Why does this spaceship completely consist of puzzles? What kind of test subjects? Is this a kind of trick?

Does the rescue shuttle indeed exist?

There is only one way to find it out. Tighten the straps of your overall to navigate in the gravity-free vacuum – and go ahead to reveal mysteries!

Estimated game duration: 4-7 hours.

short_description: You are hanging on a spaceship amidst the endless vacuum. You’ve got to options: either perish there, or collect yourself and find the fabled rescue shuttle.
